title: Job playbooks
description: Documents the AI uses when interviewing for this job only — question bank, must-ask questions, expected answers, scoring rubric. Apply to the whole job or a single round, on top of the company playbooks owned by the HR Admin.
empty: This job has no playbook of its own — the AI uses only the JD, the CV and the company playbooks.
emptyManage: No job playbook yet. Add a question bank or must-ask questions so the AI interviews on what matters for this role.
readOnlyHint: Only the job's primary Hiring Manager (or the HR Admin) can add or delete playbooks.
orphanRound: Rounds no longer in this job
deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be removed from the AI knowledge base immediately — later interviews will no longer use it.
uploadHint: PDF / DOCX / TXT / MD (max 15MB); a scoring rubric is an Excel file following the template.
selectFile: Choose a PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD file
rubricHint: A scoring rubric is an Excel sheet following the template: criterion key, display name, weight (%) and scoring standard. Weights must sum to exactly 100 — otherwise the file is rejected.

docTypeHints.question_bank: Suggested questions for the role — the AI picks and rephrases them to fit the conversation.
docTypeHints.must_ask: Questions the AI MUST ask — the interview cannot end while one is still unasked.
docTypeHints.expected_answer: What a good answer looks like — used to score and probe, never read out to the candidate.
docTypeHints.technical_scenario: Technical situations the AI poses and digs into.
docTypeHints.competency_framework: Competencies the role needs and the expected level — steers both questions and scoring.
docTypeHints.red_flag: Signals worth probing further when they show up in an answer.
docTypeHints.round_playbook: A script for one round: focus, topic order, time per part.
docTypeHints.interview_rubric: Criteria and weights for scoring this job's interviews — replaces the company rubric.
docTypeHints.cv_rubric: Criteria and weights for scoring CVs for this job.
docTypeHints.style_guide: Tone and way of asking — usually set company-wide; add here only if this role needs something different.
docTypeHints.culture_guide: The team's culture and values — usually set company-wide.
docTypeHints.compliance: Topics the AI must NEVER ask about (legal, privacy).
